title: Broome authority and dated use; Indian concessions, dated use and anaphora control

review_corrections: Walking Together volume 13 prints June 2026 on its cover; July belongs to its archive and upload route.

semantics: Conference approval, Roman recognitio, publication, exact book identity and actual use are separate events. No modern source payload or liturgical body is tracked. The existing 49 permission identities remain unchanged.

permissions.authority: Australian Catholic Bishops Conference; earlier diocesan experimental permission reported by that conference
permissions.date: 2024-05-07 conference vote; May 1973 diocesan experimental permission reported retrospectively; 2018 publication reported by conference
permissions.scope: The 2024 conference vote concerns the Diocese of Broome, Western Australia; it does not itself grant an Australia-wide use
permissions.book_or_component: Missa Terra Spiritus Sancti / Mass of the Land of the Holy Spirit; the original conference release identifies a Liturgy Brisbane 2018 publication and a printed copy presented at the 2024 plenary; full submitted book not acquired
permissions.established: The conference's original 7 May release and plenary summary distinguish its approval from subsequent submission for Roman recognitio. The release also reports the 2018 book's liturgical presentation and Warmun celebration. A diocesan 2026 newsletter directly attests the Missa at Pentecost 2026 with Bishop Tim concelebrating.
permissions.limit: Roman recognitio, its exact annex and effective date remain unverified in this bounded follow-up. Current local celebration does not supply that instrument. The original 1973 permission and the 2018 title/approval/copyright leaves, precise Eucharistic components and textual continuity into the 2024 submission and 2026 celebration remain uninspected.
permissions.locus: ACBC media release, 7 May 2024, PDF p.1 approval/subsequent submission and reported 1973 permission, p.2 Liturgy Brisbane 2018 and Warmun presentation/celebration; ACBC May plenary summary PDF p.3, Liturgy; https://broomediocese.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Walking-Together-13-Part1.pdf, PDF p.3, Pentecost 2026 – Warmun
permissions.actual_use_state: Named local adaptation's actual use attested in the conference's report and directly in the diocesan Pentecost 2026 report; exact submitted printing and Roman recognitio remain unverified.

permissions.authority: Consilium, Cardinal Benno Gut, protocol 802/69; later optional-implementation clarification reported from Cardinal Valerian Gracias, CBCI president
permissions.date: 1969-04-25 permission; March 1970 conference reaffirmation reported; 1970-02-15 dated celebration
permissions.scope: Indian ritual concessions for priests and faithful, introduced by the conference and local hierarchies where and to the extent judged fitting; dated use attested at Rome's Propaganda Fide college with its Indian community
permissions.book_or_component: Twelve permissions for posture, gestures, peace, incense, vesture, liturgical materials, preparatory ceremonial, universal prayer and arati; no new anaphora text approved by this printed letter
permissions.established: The original printed permission delegates local introduction after catechesis. The 1970 clarification calls adoption optional, whole or partial, gradual and preceded by preparation. Notitiae's contemporary notice expressly reports use of the 25 April 1969 concessions at Archbishop Simon Lourdusamy's 15 February 1970 concelebration.
permissions.limit: The celebration notice does not itemize which of the twelve concessions were enacted. No complete approved Indian altar Missal, exact service copy, parish-by-parish implementation or new Indian Eucharistic Prayer follows. The English-language Roman Order/Holy Week/Lectionary implementation reported for November 1971 and the proposed Indian anaphora must remain separate.
permissions.locus: Notitiae 5 (1969), printed pp.365–366 / PDF pp.39–40, protocol 802/69; https://www.cultodivino.va/content/dam/cultodivino/rivista-notitiae/1970/notitiae-06-%281970%29/Notitiae-052-1970.pdf, printed p.89 / PDF p.15; https://www.cultodivino.va/content/dam/cultodivino/rivista-notitiae/1970/notitiae-06-%281970%29/Notitiae-056-1970.pdf, printed p.282 / PDF p.24
permissions.actual_use_state: Use of the permitted ceremonial directly attested at the named Rome celebration, 15 February 1970; exact approved local printing and territorial adoption pattern unverified.

non_admissions.finding: The official 1973 journal's account of the April 1972 Madras meeting reports support by 60 of 81 present bishops for a proposed Indian anaphora. Its editorial footnote quotes the 30 May 1972 reply invoked for a present-members threshold, then the 24 July 1972 correction requiring two thirds of all bishops entitled to vote. The footnote also reports that the required pre-conference submission for Roman study apparently had not occurred. These passages attest a proposal and procedural dispute, not Roman approval of a new Indian anaphora or a complete 1971 Indian Order.
non_admissions.locus: Notitiae 9 (1973), printed pp.75–77 / PDF pp.33–35; III.5 spanning pp.76–77 and p.77 n.1
non_admissions.bound: The footnote's contemporary apparently-not-submitted statement is retained as such. It does not prove absence of later approval or identify the complete experimental printed order.

uses.evidence: The contemporary official journal reports Archbishop Lourdusamy's 15 February 1970 Mass at the Pontifical College of Propaganda Fide with the Indian concessions of 25 April 1969. It describes decoration, gestures, ceremony, song and instruments within the new Order of Mass; exact service copy, enacted subset of the twelve points and any new prayer text are not identified.
uses.locus: Notitiae 6 (1970), printed p.89 / PDF p.15, Peculiaritates liturgicae pro India

uses.evidence: The diocesan newsletter directly reports Fr Brian presiding at the Missa Terra Spiritus Sancti for Pentecost 2026 at Warmun, with Bishop Tim concelebrating; it does not identify the service copy or a Roman recognitio.
uses.locus: Walking Together volume 13, printed June 2026 (cover PDF p.1; July archive/upload), Part1 PDF p.3, Pentecost 2026 – Warmun

versions.qualification: Original printed permission covers twelve ritual points. Optional and prepared introduction is reiterated in 1970; dated use of the permitted ceremonial is directly reported on 15 February 1970. No new anaphora or complete Indian altar Missal is authenticated.
versions.source_locus_append: Notitiae 6 (1970) printed p.89 / PDF p.15, named 15 February 1970 celebration; printed p.282 / PDF p.24, optional whole/partial episcopal or regional implementation after preparation.

versions.title: Indian Order of Mass: reported experimental preparation
versions.qualification: The 1971 preparation remains participant-history evidence pending original book. Notitiae 9 (1973) pp.76–77 distinguishes English Roman Order implementation from the proposed Indian anaphora and prints a Roman voting-threshold correction plus the apparently unmet prior-submission requirement. Do not present the candidate as an approved complete Indian Mass order.
versions.source_locus_append: Notitiae 9 (1973) printed p.76 II.1 (required English Lectionary, Order and Holy Week use from 28 November 1971), III.5 and p.77 n.1 (separate Indian anaphora proposal and Roman procedural correction).

versions.qualification_append: The 1973 official journal describes the 1972 proposal and prints Roman procedural qualifications; it does not authenticate Roman approval or exact complete printing. Do not convert its record of 60 votes out of 81 present into a successful approval without the full voting body and governing threshold.

versions.qualification: Conference approval and named diocesan celebrations are evidenced; Roman recognitio remains unverified. The original conference release identifies a Liturgy Brisbane 2018 publication, but the 2018 original book and submitted 2024 annex are unacquired. Dated 2026 use is reception evidence for the named adaptation, not proof of an unchanged exact printing or issued Roman instrument.
versions.source_locus_append: Original ACBC release, 7 May 2024, PDF pp.1–2; May 2024 plenary summary, PDF p.3, Liturgy; Walking Together volume 13 (printed June 2026; July archive/upload), Part1 PDF pp.1,3.

sources.title: ACBC, Bishops approve Mass of the Land of the Holy Spirit, 7 May 2024
sources.inspection: Whole delivered two-page original release acquired and extracted; both pages read. Page 1 distinguishes conference approval and subsequent Roman recognitio submission and reports May 1973 experimental permission; page 2 identifies Liturgy Brisbane 2018 publication and Warmun presentation and celebration.
sources.limitations: No signed recognitio or exact 2018 book supplied. This institutional release's historical account is not the original 1973 diocesan instrument. Modern source retained only in scratch.

sources.title: ACBC General Secretariat, Summary of Bishops Plenary, May 2024
sources.inspection: Whole four-page delivered PDF acquired; PDF p.3 Liturgy paragraph read, confirming conference approval for Broome and subsequent submission for recognitio.
sources.limitations: Summary is not the signed conference motion, submitted annex or Roman recognitio. PDF metadata generation in October 2024 does not redate the May meeting. Modern source retained only in scratch.

sources.title: Diocese of Broome, Walking Together volume 13 (printed June 2026; July archive/upload), Part 1: Pentecost 2026 – Warmun
sources.inspection: Whole delivered six-page PDF acquired; text searched, PDF pp.1,3 read and visually checked. Cover explicitly gives June 2026 and volume 13, while the archive label and upload URL use July. The article directly names the Missa Terra Spiritus Sancti, Fr Brian presiding and Bishop Tim concelebrating at Pentecost 2026.
sources.limitations: Names adaptation but not exact service-copy imprint, complete components or Roman instrument. Celebration date expressed as Pentecost 2026, without an inferred civil day; July archive/upload does not redate the June printed issue. Modern source retained only in scratch.

sources.title: Peculiaritates liturgicae pro India, Notitiae 6 (1970), p.89
sources.inspection: Whole delivered 40-page PDF acquired; printed p.89 / PDF p.15 read in extracted text and visually. Notice explicitly links the 15 February 1970 Rome concelebration by Archbishop Simon Lourdusamy to the 25 April 1969 concessions.
sources.limitations: No exact service copy or new anaphora is identified; the notice is not a territorial extension decree. Modern journal retained only in scratch.

sources.title: Aptatio liturgiae in India, Notitiae 6 (1970), p.282
sources.inspection: Whole delivered 48-page PDF acquired; printed p.282 / PDF p.24 read in extracted text and visually. March 1970 episcopal reaffirmation and optional, whole/partial, gradual introduction after preparation reported, citing Cardinal Gracias and Word and Worship 3 (1970), pp.192–193.
sources.limitations: Original conference minute and Gracias communication not independently acquired; this report does not approve a new Indian anaphora or exact complete altar book. Modern journal retained only in scratch.

sources.title: India: CBCI Madras meeting, 6–14 April 1972, Notitiae 9 (1973), pp.75–77
sources.inspection: Whole delivered 48-page image-only PDF acquired. Printed pp.75–77 / PDF pp.33–35 visually read. Page 76 II.1 gives 28 November 1971 obligatory English Lectionary/Order/Holy Week implementation; III.5 and p.77 n.1 distinguish the Indian anaphora proposal, voting dispute, 30 May and 24 July 1972 Roman replies and apparently unmet prior Roman-study submission requirement.
sources.limitations: Meeting report credits D.S. Amalorpavadass, Word and Worship 5 (1972), pp.223–242; editorial footnote supplies qualifications. Neither full original letter nor complete experimental order acquired. No post-1973 approval absence asserted. Modern journal retained only in scratch.

searches.scope: Broome official authority and current reception
searches.inspected: Original ACBC 7 May 2024 release, ACBC May plenary summary Liturgy paragraph, Broome council report body, Broome Walking Together archive links, full extracted text of volume 13 parts 1 and 2 (printed June 2026; July archive/upload), visual cover date and Pentecost 2026 article.
searches.result: Conference action and local actual use verified. No recognitio instrument identified. The newsletter printed June 2026 contains a specific Mass report, but no matching recognitio in the searched text. Its July archive/upload route does not redate the printed issue.
searches.unexamined: Roman correspondence and approval annexes; exact 2018 book; every intermediate diocesan newsletter; every later ACBC plenary or private record. Search failure is not an absence claim.

searches.inspected: Notitiae 1969 printed pp.365–366, 1970 p.89 and p.282, 1973 pp.75–77 with visual n.1; 1965–1975 index India/adaptation loci searched; 1975 nos.105 and 108–109 text layers searched for Indian anaphora/reply leads.
searches.result: Original concession, optional conditions and dated use verified; 1973 procedural qualification verified. No exact approved 1971 book identified.
searches.unexamined: Other 1969 and 1970 issue pages beyond relevant loci; 1973 report's cited original Word and Worship 5 (1972) pp.223–242; full 1972 letters; original experimental order; purported May 1975 reply. Notitiae 106–107 text layer was searched without an Indian-anaphora match; its image pages were not reviewed, so this is only a text-search bound.

leads_not_promoted.disposition: No original signed reply or official full text acquired; do not import the reprints' legal conclusion or purported quotations as verified.
